# RailHygiene

> RailHygiene is an independent Android app and website for community-sourced cleanliness ratings of Indian Railways train coaches. It is not affiliated with Indian Railways or IRCTC.

## Main pages

- [RailHygiene](https://railhygiene.in/): Check how the service works and download the Android app.
- [RailMadad vs RailHygiene](https://railhygiene.in/railmadad-vs-railhygiene.html): Use RailMadad or 139 for immediate official assistance; use RailHygiene to check and share community cleanliness ratings.
- [Live data dashboard](https://railhygiene.in/dashboard.html): View aggregated coach-cleanliness data.
- [Privacy policy](https://railhygiene.in/privacy.html): Learn how anonymous identifiers, PNR verification, and feedback data are handled.
- [Terms of use](https://railhygiene.in/terms.html): Service terms and independence disclaimer.

## App

- [Download RailHygiene on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nish.railhygiene)
